summary: Implemented KAFKA-20444 to align TxnOffsetCommit API with OffsetCommit API (KIP-1319). Added metadata refresh logic in KafkaProducer.sendOffsetsToTransaction to ensure topic IDs are available when Transaction V2 is enabled, enabling negotiation of TxnOffsetCommit v6+ which requires topic IDs. Modified three methods: sendOffsetsToTransaction to trigger metadata refresh, awaitTopicMetadata to wait for topic IDs, and added topicsWithoutTopicIds helper. All tests pass including the two new KIP-1319 tests and existing transaction tests.
